claims.source: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and GenAI
claims.note: Official OWASP material verifies Excessive Agency, Supply Chain, Data and Model Poisoning, Improper Output Handling, Vector and Embedding Weaknesses, and Unbounded Consumption. Exact 2026 numbering is not hard-coded here because the currently indexed official material clearly exposes the 2025 taxonomy and a separate 2026 resource entry.
The implementation enforces independent verification as a security control, but does not represent the supplied legislative attribution as verified law.
Pattern matching is a deterministic pre-flight signal, not proof that a tool is safe.
Source, timestamp, and review attribution are required; provenance does not prove semantic safety.
